title: The Truth About Campus Life:
body: I’ll be honest: I thought I was getting a special deal at NIAT. During admission, they mesmerized me with talk of 'exclusive discounts' for my IPE scores and EAPCET rank. But on day one, I realized it was all just talk—everyone I asked had the exact same fee structure. It felt like a bit of a cheat. That being said, I have to admit that campus life here is on another level compared to standard B.Tech colleges. It’s just a shame they felt the need to hide the real fee structure behind marketing 'lies' instead of just being upfront about the value they offer.
excerpt: They promised me 'exclusive discounts' for my EAPCET rank during admission. Day one reality check: everyone paid the same fees. Here's what actually happened.
meta_title: NIAT Kadapa Fee Structure Reality: What They Don't Tell You
meta_description: Promised exclusive discounts during admission? A current NIAT student reveals the truth about fee structures and why campus life still impressed despite the marketing tactics.
